BiblicalUsage: Poti-pherah is the priest of On, and his name touches Joseph's story at its turning point. Pharaoh gives Joseph Asenath, the daughter of Poti-pherah, as his wife, and she bears him Manasseh and Ephraim. The priest of the sun god becomes, through his daughter, the grandfather of two tribes of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God weaves even the priest of On into the line of promise, and no family is too far outside for him to use. Asenath's sons carry the blessing forward.
